blocks.text: COTABATO CITY — An alleged Malaysian drug peddler carrying suspected shabu worth P13.4 million and his Filipino cohort were killed in a shootout with Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency (PDEA) operatives in Tawi-Tawi, an official confirmed on Monday.
